thread:
carmen: PM wants a tiny sandbox: choose a % to reroute to a cheaper model variant, toggle prefetch, and get an immediate estimate (cost delta, cache savings, latency impact). Can infra give feasibility and a minimal API contract?
josh: Minimal telemetry we need: per-model+route minute rollups with token_count, cache_prefix_hits, seq_len_bucket_fracs (4 fixed buckets), and p50/p95 latency. Keep tenant out of the schema to limit cardinality.
rachel: Agree. MV approach: router emits minute rollups labelled by model+route+env. Store last 60m in a fast MV for quick reads; recompute every 2-5m.
leo: API sketch (JSON-only): POST /internal/sim/quick with body: {model, alt_model, route, reroute_pct, window_mins, cache_override?, seq_buckets?}. Response: {pred_cost_delta, pred_latency_delta, est_tokens, ci_low, ci_high, drivers, assumptions}. Keep the payload small.
ux-kim: UX: inline compact card on route page. Controls: slider 0-100%, prefetch toggle, preset dropdown (e.g., "shift 20% to quant-small"). Show three compact numbers and a tiny "Explain" that lists top drivers and assumptions. Add CTA "apply to canary" to prefill rollout.
josh: Fast path: use last-5m MV and simple per-bucket math to produce sub-second responses. Slow path: aggregate longer window for tighter CI. Avoid heavy histogram math.
rachel: Cardinality rule: do not index MV by tenant. Tenant-level previews can accept a tenant_override param but compute on best-effort sampling.
leo: Security: gate to platform_admins/beta_orgs. Redact raw token counts for org viewers that don't own the data; show percent/ratios instead.
carmen: Monitoring/validation: emit sim_request_total, sim_latency_ms, sim_error_pct. Daily job computes sim_error per-model: abs(pred-actual)/actual. If median error > 25% for 3 days, flag. Store only aggregated validation stats.
ux-kim: UX add-on: show a tiny sim_error sparkline on the card so PMs can eyeball reliability. Label outputs as estimates and link to "explain assumptions".
josh: Prototype tasks: 1) router emitter proto, 2) MV store + aggregator job, 3) sim service + auth, 4) console widget + gating. MVP (last-5m on demand) ~2-3 weeks; full accuracy ~2-3 months.
sim-bot: created ticket SIM-6172 assigned to josh/rachel. CI job queued. :gear:
carmen: OK thanks. @josh @rachel please drop emitter proto + example request/response by EOD. I'll coordinate beta list with PM. :thumbsup:
